prompt.project_info: Create a playful warm photorealistic art-room portrait of an approved adult woman reaching a paintbrush toward the camera.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with natural dark hair, gentle smile, clean skin texture, and natural makeup lies forward on a wooden floor, extending one arm toward the lens with a paintbrush. She wears a pink satin spaghetti-strap slip dress with realistic sheen and folds. Her hand and brush carry blush pink, dusty rose, magenta, soft coral, and pastel-pink paint smudges.
prompt.composition_elements: 3:4 portrait with the foreground brush and paint-covered hand closest to lens and sharp, face softly blurred but recognizable, cozy art room with wooden floor, shelves, plants, canvases, and window light behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft window daylight with gentle room bounce, warm playful artsy mood, natural filmic color, shallow depth of field, realistic paint residue and satin highlights.
prompt.technical_specs: Sony A7SIII-style camera, 35mm prime, f/1.8, foreground-object focus, natural skin texture, subtle 35mm grain, no HDR, 3:4 crop.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 3:4 lifestyle art portrait of an approved adult woman with natural dark hair, clean skin texture, natural makeup, and a gentle smile lying forward on a wooden floor in a cozy art room. She reaches one arm toward the camera holding a paintbrush extremely close to the lens; the brush and paint-covered hand are sharp while her recognizable face is softly blurred. She wears a pink satin spaghetti-strap slip dress with realistic sheen and folds. Use blush pink, dusty rose, magenta, soft coral, and pastel-pink paint smudges on fingers, palm, brush, and a few subtle floor drops. Include shelves, plants, canvases, warm wooden floor, and soft window daylight with gentle room bounce. Use 35mm f/1.8, natural filmic range, realistic texture, and subtle grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, random text, logo
